name: Marshmallow Fluff Original Marshmallow Creme
whyItWorks: Made from corn syrup, sugar syrup, dried egg whites, and vanillin. Completely free of dairy, fat, and fiber; pure soft marshmallow cloud that dissolves instantly in the mouth.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Spread over white sourdough toast or dip with gluten-free pretzel sticks for a safe sweet treat.
